subject: Medivance Pilot — Launch Responsibilities & Risk Triage
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@medivance.com>, Leah Kim <leah.kim@medivance.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Nov 2027 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Medivance Pilot — Launch Responsibilities & Risk Triage

Hi team,

We closed the Medivance pilot yesterday. Quick summary so CS can pick up operational ownership:

- Scope: 3-month pilot (RDW-2381) — hosting Redwood-owned model endpoint, ingesting up to 100k messages/month, embedding search with weekly sync.
- Acceptance criteria: 95% availability during business hours, response latency < 350ms p50, demo queries pass the accuracy set in the SOW.
- Security: SOC2 controls for logs; customer requires 30-day PII retention (see SOW).
- Integrations: they will push events to our ingestion API and want SSO via SAML (Leah is the IdP contact).
- Go-live target: first-week-of-December sandbox -> pilot week-of-12/13.

Attachments: Medivance_SOW_v2.pdf, integration_spec.xlsx, mutual_action_plan.md (drive link below).

Asks for CS:
1) Confirm primary + backup owners.
2) Share onboarding timeline with key milestones and handoff tasks (API keys, sandbox creds, SAML config, weekly status cadence).
3) Identify any immediate risk (quota, custom transforms, data retention gaps).

I'm suggesting Dylan as primary and Marissa as secondary, but open to alternate assignments.

Thanks — I’ll join the kickoff to introduce the customer and unblock procurement if needed.

Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
https://redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@medivance.com>, Leah Kim <leah.kim@medivance.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Medivance Pilot — Launch Responsibilities & Risk Triage

Thanks Olga — congrats on the close.

Quick clarifying Qs before we confirm owners and timeline:
- Data retention: SOW says 30 days but the integration spec has a 90-day default. Can procurement confirm which takes precedence? (Procurement folks, can you confirm?)
- SAML details: Leah, can you share the IdP metadata file and confirm whether group mapping is required?
- Sandbox volume: will the sandbox mirror production volumes (100k/mo) or be throttled? Need for load testing if production-like.

We'll draft a 30/60/90 onboarding checklist once we confirm the above. Dylan — are you comfortable picking up primary? If so, can you own the first-week sandbox validation (API keys + smoke tests)?

Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 646-555-0199
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@medivance.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Leah Kim <leah.kim@medivance.com>, procurement@medivance.com
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2027 11:07:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Medivance Pilot — Launch Responsibilities & Risk Triage

Hi all — quick answers from Medivance side:
- Retention: Procurement confirms contract-level retention is 30 days. We can sign the updated SOW.
- SAML: Leah will share metadata today; group mapping not required for pilot.
- Sandbox: Sandbox can be provisioned at ~50% of production volume for the first two weeks; we can ramp after smoke testing.
- Weekly cadence: prefer Wednesdays 10am ET for sync (first one after kickoff).

Thanks — excited to get started. I’ll route the signed SOW this afternoon to procurement@medivance.com.

— Sanjay Rao
Director of Product Integrations | Medivance Health
sanjay.rao@medivance.com | +1 212-555-0172
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2027 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Medivance Pilot — Launch Responsibilities & Risk Triage

Thanks — happy to be primary. Proposed owner roster: 
- Primary CS: Dylan Brooks (owner, sandbox & smoke tests, weekly status)
- Secondary CS: Marissa Cole (acceptance criteria, onboarding playbook, escalation lead)
- Engineering contact (runtime): Karthik Iyer (kernel selection, latency tuning)

Immediate asks for sales/customer:
- Olga / Sanjay: sandbox tenancy + service account (sandbox@example.com) + initial API key so we can run smoke tests.
- Leah: SAML metadata + test IdP account.

Pre-kickoff checklist (I’ll draft and share by EOD Thursday):
1) Verify sandbox creds and run smoke tests (connectivity, basic query flow, embeddings pipeline).
2) Confirm quota and throttling behavior in sandbox.
3) Confirm log export and retention config to meet 30-day rule.

Risks: custom pre-processing for Medivance's medical abbreviations may require a short transform; I’ll surface this after sandbox tests.

Dylan Brooks

Dylan / Marissa — please use the mutual action plan at the Drive link and add owners + dates to the first three milestones: sandbox validation, SAML config, and pilot go/no-go decision. Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/medivance-onboarding

Olga (for clarity):
- Primary: Dylan Brooks
- Secondary: Marissa Cole
- Engineering: Karthik Iyer (support for runtime tuning)

Kickoff: I scheduled a 45-minute kickoff for Wednesday 12/1 at 10am ET — calendar invite sent to all. Please confirm and add any pre-reads.

Open items for Sales: procurement expected to return signed SOW by EOD today (Sanjay). If procurement stalls, I’ll provide one-time credit fallback to keep sandbox live for 72 hours.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to a smooth kick-off.
